scope_note: The 2012 exhibition page (caption and partial transcription) and facsimiles of leaves 45 and 47 of the signed original, read from raw Internet Archive captures made before the cutoff because the official host timed out. It corroborates the gazette text of Law 2392-I and adds no office holder. The capture of leaf 46 timed out and was not viewed.

visual_review.method: Leaves 45 and 47 viewed at full size by the dossier and the check; leaf 47 viewed again by this packet (Articles 6-9, the autograph over the seal, the date and number). The caption was read in the page capture.

rows.text: Rosarkhiv describes the item as 'Подлинник. Машинопись. Подпись-автограф Президента СССР М.С. Горбачева' (GARF F. R-9654, Op. 1, D. 184, L. 45-47). Leaf 45, marked 'Подлежит опубликованию', carries Articles 1-2 as in the gazette (two chambers, the Council of Republics and the Council of the Union); leaf 47 carries Articles 6-9, the signature 'Президент Союза Советских Социалистических Республик (М.Горбачев)' with an autograph over the seal of the Congress of People's Deputies of the USSR, and 'Москва, Кремль. 5 сентября 1991 г. № 2392-I'.
